issues.detail: The Non-goals heading check `^##\s+Non-?goals` (flags mi) would miss a heading written "## Non goals". The template prescribes "## Non-goals", which the regex matches case-insensitively, so a template-following run passes.
issues.fix: Optionally widen to `^##\s+Non[- ]?goals` in spec.json checks[3].

issues.detail: "Does not add the level to STATE.md" is enforced deterministically only through `ActiveWork.Request unchanged`. A new level field would also break check/parse or be visible to the judge, so this is adequate.

summary: The fixture realizes every stated condition: a brownfield STANDARD cycle in SCOPING with Scope NONE, inactive recovery, a Level 3 request, and Auditor context describing a FastAPI service with no survey features. check.mjs is ok and the selfCheck passes. The checks are necessary conditions a correct PLAN-mode run satisfies (default scope path, provenance, AC list items, Level 3 under Constraints, a Non-goals heading, request unchanged), and the invariants fit Scoper; no hints leak.
